and Verne have begun fully driverless robotaxi test rides with passengers on public roads in Zagreb, Croatia, marking what the companies describe as a European first.

The tests are running along a 22-kilometer route connecting Verne’s headquarters and a major Zagreb business district with Franjo Tuđman Airport. The companies plan to expand the driverless operating area across Zagreb in the coming months.
